proved_step: LEMMA (single gate, existential auxiliaries): for every k >= 4 and every m >= 0, there are no a in Z_3^k, b in Z_3^m, c in Z_3 with [exists y in {0,1}^m: a.x + b.y = c (mod 3)] = [|x| = 1] for all x in {0,1}^k. PROOF: T = {b.y mod 3} contains 0, so the gate equals [a.x in V] with V = c - T nonempty. |V|=0 or 3: f constant, impossible. |V|=1, V={v}: f(e_i)=1 gives a=v.1, f(0)=0 gives v != 0, and the weight-4 point gives 4v = v in V so f=1, contradicting |x|=4. |V|=2: f(0)=0 forces V={1,2}, so a.x=0 iff |x| != 1; then a_i != 0 and a_i + a_j = 0 for all i != j, which for k >= 3 gives a_2 = a_3 = -a_2, so a_2 = 0, contradiction.
